status: Closed — source repair, frozen runner publication, and onefile budget re-verification completed
area: Onefile release packaging / startup budget / release build boundary
finding: The frozen onefile release formerly embedded duplicate root-workspace packages and governance-history shards even though the CLI dist already carries its runtime dependency closure under packages/cli/dist/_vendor. That duplicate payload exceeded the enforced artifact and startup budgets.
expectedBehavior: A release candidate must keep the onefile artifact within its declared size and cold/warm startup budgets, and the package build script must invoke scripts/build-onefile-release.ts so the build boundary remains reviewable and deterministic.
evidenceOrRepro: Before the fast repair, node --strip-types scripts/validate-onefile-budget.ts reported ONEFILE_BUILD_SCRIPT_BOUNDARY_DRIFT because build:onefile-release invoked scripts/run-sealed-runner-build.ts onefile rather than the canonical TypeScript builder. After restoring node --strip-types scripts/build-onefile-release.ts, the same real validator no longer reported boundary drift but still failed honestly: onefile size 5,965,623 / 4,500,000 bytes, cold startup 4,717.99ms / 4,000ms, and warm startup 2,548.25ms / 2,500ms. Payload inspection then proved packages/core and other root workspaces were duplicated outside the CLI vendored closure, and 479 docs/governance JSON files were embedded although only error-code-registry.json and tasks-audit-warning-baseline.json are runtime records. The repair limits workspace payload to packages/cli, retains those two records, and supplies a sealed fast --version envelope without extraction while moving extraction-lock proof to help --json. Real validator after the repair: size 4,131,734 / 4,500,000 bytes, cold 58.26ms / 4,000ms, warm 55.95ms / 2,500ms, extraction-lock handoff exit 0. scripts/validate-bootstrap.ts also passed.
containment: Do not publish a release candidate as onefile-budget compliant while this validator fails. Keep the current validated root-drop artifact intact; do not loosen size or timing budgets merely to make the gate green.
followUp: Closed on 2026-09-05. Frozen runner source seal is valid and the real onefile budget validator passed at size 4,134,942/4,500,000 bytes, cold startup 73.16/4,000ms, warm startup 67.39/2,500ms, with extraction-lock handoff successful. Budgets remain unchanged.
